from pathlib import Path
import math

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    coords = [(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    score_diff = len({c-r for r,c,v in coords})
    score_sum = len({c+r for r,c,v in coords})
    use_sum = score_sum < score_diff
    offsets = [r+c if use_sum else c-r for r,c,v in coords]
    vals = [v for r,c,v in coords]
    period = next(p for p in range(1, max(h,w)+1) if all(len({v for d,v in zip(offsets, vals) if d%p==k}) <= 1 for k in range(p)))
    mapping = {}
    for d,v in zip(offsets,vals):
        mapping[d%period] = v
    return [[mapping.get(((r+c) if use_sum else (c-r))%period, 0) for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

def make_diag_grid(n, lines, plus=False):
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for d,v in lines.items():
        for r in range(n):
            c=d-r if plus else r+d
            if 0<=c<n: g[r][c]=v
    return g

demo1=make_diag_grid(28,{2:4,17:9,-8:3,-3:1,-25:1,-12:7,-18:7,27:2})
demo2=make_diag_grid(12,{1:3,-5:3,3:8,5:1,6:2,-7:5,-10:5})
test=make_diag_grid(28,{9:1,28:5,36:3,50:3,52:4},plus=True)
for name,g in [('demo1',demo1),('demo2',demo2),('test',test)]:
    out=transform(g)
    print(name, 'unique row',out[0], 'patt',len(out[0]))
    print('first rows',out[:2])

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    diag = [c-r for r,c,v in pts]
    anti = [r+c for r,c,v in pts]
    use_sum = len(set(anti)) < len(set(diag))
    offsets = [r+c if use_sum else c-r for r,c,v in pts]
    period = len(set(offsets))
    mapping = {}
    for d,(_,_,v) in zip(offsets,pts):
        k=d%period
        if k in mapping and mapping[k] != v:
            raise ValueError('inconsistent line colors')
        mapping[k]=v
    return [[mapping[((r+c) if use_sum else (c-r))%period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
